description: This file defines the MigrationHubClient class which extends the AwsClient class and provides methods to interact with the AWS Migration Hub service, including actions such as associating artifacts, disassociating resources, listing migration tasks, and other migration-related operations. The class includes method annotations indicating both synchronous and asynchronous methods for each operation.

classes.name: MigrationHubClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Migration Hub service, extending the base AwsClient class.

methods.name: associateCreatedArtifact
methods.description: Associates a created artifact with a resource in Migration Hub.

methods.name: associateCreatedArtifactAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a created artifact with a resource in Migration Hub.

methods.name: associateDiscoveredResource
methods.description: Associates a discovered resource with a migration task.

methods.name: associateDiscoveredResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a discovered resource with a migration task.

methods.name: associateSourceResource
methods.description: Associates a resource with a source in Migration Hub.

methods.name: associateSourceResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a resource with a source in Migration Hub.

methods.name: createProgressUpdateStream
methods.description: Creates a new progress update stream.

methods.name: createProgressUpdateStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new progress update stream.

methods.name: deleteProgressUpdateStream
methods.description: Deletes an existing progress update stream.

methods.name: deleteProgressUpdateStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a progress update stream.

methods.name: describeApplicationState
methods.description: Describes the current application state in Migration Hub.

methods.name: describeApplicationStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the current application state.

methods.name: disassociateCreatedArtifact
methods.description: Disassociates a created artifact from a resource.

methods.name: disassociateSourceResource
methods.description: Disassociates a resource from a source.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies Migration Hub of application state changes.

methods.name: notifyApplicationStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies about application state changes.

methods.name: notifyMigrationTaskState
methods.description: Notifies Migration Hub of migration task state changes.

methods.name: notifyMigrationTaskStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies about migration task state changes.
